state.load_one: ret = request_firmware_direct(&fw, fw_name, dev); if (ret) return dev_err_probe(dev, ret == -ENOENT ? -EPROBE_DEFER : ret, ...); if (fw->size > fw_max_size) { ret = -E2BIG; goto out; } memcpy_toio(addr, fw->data, fw->size); out: release_firmware(fw); return ret;
state.load_pair: ret = airoha_npu_load_firmware(dev, addr, fw_names[0], NPU_EN7581_FIRMWARE_RV32_MAX_SIZE); if (ret) return ret; return airoha_npu_load_firmware(dev, base + REG_NPU_LOCAL_SRAM, fw_names[1], NPU_EN7581_FIRMWARE_DATA_MAX_SIZE);
state.watchdog_work: dump = vzalloc(NPU_DUMP_SIZE); if (!dump) return; c = core - &npu->cores[0]; regmap_bulk_read(npu->regmap, REG_PC_DBG(c), val, ARRAY_SIZE(val)); snprintf(dump, NPU_DUMP_SIZE, ...); dev_coredumpv(npu->dev, dump, NPU_DUMP_SIZE, GFP_KERNEL);
state.existing_evidence: The reset-controller map and callback tests execute modeled regmap. Stock GDMA instruction tests model register status and bus work. Neither executes real hardware resets or bus drains.

pair_preflight.instructions: Do state.load_one and state.load_pair establish that both images are obtained and size-validated before the first firmware memory write?

data_failure_effect.instructions: After successful code loading, what effect is established if the second firmware request fails or its size exceeds the maximum? Use state.load_one and state.load_pair.

criteria.code_already_written: The first code image has already been copied even though the second image fails.
criteria.no_firmware_written: Both images were validated before either copy.
criteria.unknown: The supplied code does not establish the write order.

empty_image.instructions: Does state.load_one explicitly reject a successfully requested image with size zero before returning success?

watchdog_restart.instructions: Does state.watchdog_work perform a core reset or firmware restart? Treat dump capture as a diagnostic action.

physical_coverage.instructions: Does state.reset_mappings together with state.existing_evidence prove that asserting only the NPU reset drains all GDMA bus work?

criteria.proved: Physical reset and bus-drain evidence establishes the assertion for every GDMA user.
criteria.not_established: Separate register mappings and modeled callbacks do not establish physical whole-engine drain semantics.
